column1: # Stable release tags built as SERVER-ONLY releases: API, web, portal and the
# M365 executor images are rebuilt from the tagged commit; the agent family,
# Viewer, Helper, installers, recovery media and the binaries image are carried
# forward unchanged from a named full-release base.
# FORMAT  <tag><TAB><exact tag commit><TAB><base full-release tag><TAB><note>
# A row authorizes a server-only build of exactly that commit against exactly
# that base. The eligibility guard (scripts/release/run-server-only-guard.sh)
# is executed from the BASE release's tree, never the candidate's, and refuses
# unless: the tag is the globally highest stable version; the commit is on
# main; the base is the highest stable non-server-only ancestor tag; and no
# path in the base's scripts/release/binary-affecting-paths.txt changed between
# the base and the commit.
# Release creation and promotion read the authoritative copy from origin/main;
# an unmerged branch cannot declare itself. A tag that is not listed is a full
# release. A server-only release is always created as a draft and is published
# only through release-promotion.yml, which re-runs the guard.
# Append-only once the tag exists on the remote: PR CI refuses edits to, or
# removal of, a row whose tag has been pushed. A row for a tag that has not been
# pushed yet may be removed.
